title: A female gray with a baby gray at the Mount Zeil base

tellings.quote: I saw a gray female with a baby gray.

plain: At a base at Mount Zeil, a mountain in Australia, a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he saw a female "gray", one of the small grey-skinned beings of UFO lore, together with a baby gray. Buchanan tells it as something he saw himself, put simply: "I saw a gray female with a baby gray." If true, it would mean such beings have young.
